subject: Multi-vendor renewal kickoff: GitHub Enterprise / JetBrains / Atlassian
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Multi-vendor renewal kickoff: GitHub / JetBrains / Atlassian

Hi team —

We have a cluster of renewals coming up across our developer productivity stack and I want to get ahead of coordination. High level:

- GitHub Enterprise (org-wide) — annual seats, renewal window around late June.
- JetBrains All Products Pack — staggered teams, some seats renew in July.
- Atlassian (Jira/Confluence) — renewal in early August; want to explore consolidated billing / cloud credits.

Attached is a quick master sheet with current dates and seat counts. Can each of you:

1) Confirm the teams you own that are affected and any special procurement constraints.
2) Share any existing discount commitments or SSO/KMS clauses that procurement must preserve.
3) Call out any integration work that might require an SOW (e.g., repo migration, SSO enforcement, plugin licensing).

Goal: one coordinated timeline and a single procurement pack (PO + consolidated invoices if vendors will allow). I can own vendor outreach with sales reps, but need procurement logistics from Ben.

Thanks — short replies OK.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: renewal_windows.xlsx (xlsx, 48KB)]
From: Daniel Park <eng-sales@github.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Multi-vendor renewal kickoff: GitHub / JetBrains / Atlassian

Hi Marissa & Soojin —

Thanks for the heads up. Quick notes from GitHub:

- We received the seat counts in the attached PDF and have a draft renewal quote ready.
- Standard renewal window: we need the signed order form 30–45 days before expiration to lock pricing.
- Possible volume discount at 5% at the threshold you provided; we can extend an additional 2% for a 12‑month committed purchase if you consolidate purchases across product lines.

I've attached the draft quote (GHE_quote_Q2.pdf). If consolidation across vendors (single invoice/PO) is desired, we can provide invoice-only terms but need a billing contact and a billing address that matches PO.

Available for a 30-minute sync this week if helpful.

Best,
Daniel Park
Enterprise Sales, GitHub
[Attachment: GHE_quote_Q2.pdf (pdf, 124KB)]
From: JetBrains Renewals <renewals@jetbrains.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Multi-vendor renewal kickoff: JetBrains terms

Hello Marissa and Soojin,

Thanks for reaching out. We reviewed the seat list and included line-level pricing in the CSV attached. A few items to flag:

- Education/OSS discounts do not apply to enterprise accounts.
- We can offer a 7% multi-year discount if you commit for 24 months across all teams.
- SSO + centralized license server setup usually takes 2–3 business days of professional services if you have existing SSO metadata ready.

Please review JB_quote_line_items.csv and confirm whether you prefer an annual or 24-month term by EOD May 20 so we can finalize paperwork.

Regards,
JetBrains Renewals Team
[Attachment: JB_quote_line_items.csv (csv, 18KB)]
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: eng-sales@github.com, renewals@jetbrains.com, atlas-sales@atlassian.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 13:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Multi-vendor renewal kickoff: consolidated ask & PO process

Hi all —

Thanks for the quick turn. To keep this moving on our side, a few requests / constraints from Procurement & Finance:

- Preferred consolidation: one PO covering GHE + JetBrains + Atlassian with vendor sub-lines, if each vendor can support invoice-only terms. Please confirm if billing address and PO fields you need differ from the ones in the Drive doc.
- Timing: we need signed agreements/DOs no later than May 27 to meet internal payment cycles for June renewals.
- Security/compliance: SOC 2 Type II reports and a data-retention clause are required; if you have standard language, please include.

Action items for vendors:
- Provide a single-page invoiceable order form (or confirmation that you can accept a consolidated PO).
- Append SOC 2 attestation and a standard DPA (or a pointer to your DPA portal).
- If any professional services are required (e.g., JetBrains license server or Atlassian migration), include estimated hours and a separate SOW.

Marissa / Ben — please use the Drive sheet (link below) to confirm GL codes and team allocations. I'll set up a vendor call Wed 5/12 10:00 PT to walk through one consolidated ask. If vendors cannot consolidate billing, call that out and provide the fastest way to sign per-vendor.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2bRenewalMasterSheet
DocuSign template (procurement): https://www.docusign.com/en/redwood/renewal-packages/12345

Thanks —
Soojin Lee
Director, Procurement | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Renewal_MATP.pdf (pdf, 56KB)]
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 16:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Multi-vendor renewal kickoff: procurement next steps

Quick procurement checklist and timeline summary:

- Now (5/12): Confirm GL codes & team allocations in the renewal master sheet (Marissa to update).
- By 5/18: Vendors to provide final invoiceable order forms (or confirmation of consolidated PO support).
- By 5/20: Internal approvals (Finance sign-off, legal redline check).
- By 5/27: Signed orders in DocuSign to meet payment window for June/July renewals.

PO details:
- Use Redwood GL 4012 for platform tools; split lines by team code in the sheet.
- For multi-vendor invoice: procurement will accept a single PDF invoice with vendor sub-lines; vendors must confirm billing contact and remit instructions.

Risks / escalations:
- If any vendor requires an extended legal review (non-standard DPA) notify me immediately so I can pull legal in — that will add 7–10 days.
- If JetBrains professional services are required, route SOW via PS procurement and we will create a separate PO.

I'll host the vendor sync tomorrow at 10:00 PT and will record minutes. Thanks everyone for quick responses.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Finance Ops | Redwood Inference
